output.headline: UPMC has closed three Healthcare Services deals, all in the target's own sub-sector, and has US$27.7 billion of revenue behind a $200M Midwest purchase. [B:buyer, T:record, P:1]
output.differentiator: Its deal record is entirely in the target's own sub-sector, 3 of 3 closed, and its US$27.7 billion revenue base is ample to fund the ask. No peer comparison was provided. [T:record, K:closed_share, P:1]
output.why_them: Same sub-sector as the target; every past deal closed; large balance sheet

acquirer_overview.title: A large strategic with a short, fully closed record
points: Strategic buyer with hospitals in Pennsylvania, Maryland and New York; Washington Health System merged with UPMC in 2024. [B:buyer, P:2]
Three deals from 2018 to 2020, all closed and all control deals, with a median size of $55M. [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share]
Ranks 3rd on the priority list of 10 and 4th of 107 buyers scored, at a likelihood of 4.7%. [R:rank]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Home sub-sector buyer for a high-margin Healthcare Services asset
points: Share of deals in the target's sub-sector is the strongest factor; margin fit is a strong factor. All 3 deals were Healthcare Services. [S:sector_share, S:margin_fit, K:by_sub_sector]
Motives: Platform Build in 1 of 3 deals (23% of all deals in file) and Cross-sell in 1 of 3 (21%), so the target could be an add-on. [M:platform_build, M:cross_sell]
Geographic Expansion appears in 2 of 3 deals but also in 90% of all deals in file, so it is not a distinct motive. [M:geographic_expansion]

precedent_activity.title: Three same-sub-sector deals, one near the target's size
points: Principal Behavioral Health, $444M Bolt-on Acquisition (2019) at 11.7x EV/EBITDA, its largest deal. [D:MA-2019-0090]
Sterling Care Network, $55M Strategic Acquisition (2020) at 11.3x. Keystone Behavioral Health, $33M Recapitalization (2018) at 17.0x. [D:MA-2020-0312, D:MA-2018-0486]
None of the 3 deals falls in the $100M-$400M comparable size band, and none was in the Midwest. [K:size_band, T:record]

valuation_context.title: A 75th percentile case, within reach of its capacity
points: Comparable deals (70) show 10.7x at the 25th percentile, 12.8x at the median and 15.3x at the 75th percentile. [V:comps]
The 16.8% margin is above the 12.9% comp median and above 87% of comps, supporting the 75th percentile. [V:comps, X:target]
Its median paid is 11.7x, below the 75th percentile, but synergy headroom of $15M-$25M can bridge the gap. [V:comps, V:synergy]

risk_flags.title: Dormant acquirer
risk_flags.concern: No deals since 2022 and the last deal was in 2020; recency is a slight factor against. [K:recent, S:recency]
risk_flags.mitigant: The 2024 Washington Health System merger shows continued corporate activity. [P:2]
risk_flags.reality: Three deals in total is a thin record; appetite should be tested on the call. [T:record]

risk_flags.title: Size and region stretch
risk_flags.concern: None of its 3 deals falls in the $100M-$400M band, and none was in the Midwest. [K:size_band, T:record]
risk_flags.mitigant: Its $444M deal shows it can transact above the target's size. [D:MA-2019-0090]
risk_flags.reality: Its stated footprint is Pennsylvania, Maryland and New York, so the Midwest is a new region. [P:2]

risk_flags.title: Price gap to the defensible level
risk_flags.concern: Its median paid of 11.7x sits below the 15.3x 75th percentile we would defend. [V:comps]
risk_flags.mitigant: Synergy headroom of $15M-$25M and one 17.0x precedent show room to stretch. [V:synergy, D:MA-2018-0486]
risk_flags.reality: At the 75th percentile, EBITDA of $13.1M is needed at the $200M EV. [V:comps]

conviction.rationale: All 3 deals are in the target's own sub-sector, none in adjacent provider sub-sectors; no Midwest deal is neutral; it remains #3 on the priority list after review. [C:conviction, R:rank]
